windows.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path 'assets/img' | Out-Null; Get-ChildItem 'assets/raw' -Filter '*.jpg' | ForEach-Object { $base = $_.BaseName; magick $_.FullName -resize 400x -quality 80 (Join-Path 'assets/img' ($base + '-mobile.jpg')); magick $_.FullName -resize 1000x -quality 85 (Join-Path 'assets/img' ($base + '-desktop.jpg')) }"

linux.command: mkdir -p assets/img && for f in assets/raw/*.jpg; do base=$(basename "$f" .jpg); magick "$f" -resize 400x -quality 80 "assets/img/${base}-mobile.jpg"; magick "$f" -resize 1000x -quality 85 "assets/img/${base}-desktop.jpg"; done

osx.command: mkdir -p assets/img && for f in assets/raw/*.jpg; do base=$(basename "$f" .jpg); magick "$f" -resize 400x -quality 80 "assets/img/${base}-mobile.jpg"; magick "$f" -resize 1000x -quality 85 "assets/img/${base}-desktop.jpg"; done
